name: Git cheatsheet
description: Searchable reference of everyday Git commands, from setup and branching to undoing mistakes.

name: Random port generator
description: Pick random TCP/UDP port numbers from the registered or dynamic range, skipping well-known services.

name: SQL formatter
description: Format and indent SQL queries for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server and other dialects.

name: Chmod calculator
description: Convert Unix file permissions between octal and symbolic notation, with a checkbox grid.

name: Docker run to Compose
description: Convert docker run commands to Docker Compose YAML, and Compose services back to docker run.

name: XML formatter
description: Pretty-print or minify XML, check that it is well-formed, and choose the indentation.

name: YAML formatter
description: Format and validate YAML documents, with indentation, key sorting and line width options.

name: Email normalizer
description: Normalize email addresses by lowercasing them, stripping plus tags and Gmail dots, and removing duplicates.

name: Regex cheatsheet
description: Searchable reference of regular expression syntax: character classes, anchors, groups, lookarounds and flags.

name: JSON Schema validator
description: Validate JSON against a JSON Schema, or generate a starting schema from sample JSON.

name: JSON to types
description: Generate TypeScript, Go, Rust or Python type definitions from a sample JSON document.

name: JSONPath playground
description: Query JSON documents with JSONPath expressions and see each matching value and its path.

name: Patch applier
description: Apply a unified diff patch to text and see the patched result, or which hunks failed and why.

name: Semver calculator
description: Compare and sort semantic versions, and test which versions satisfy an npm-style range.

name: .gitignore generator
description: Build a .gitignore file by combining templates for languages, frameworks, editors and operating systems.

name: Dockerfile linter
description: Check a Dockerfile for common mistakes and best-practice issues, with an explanation for each finding.

name: Kubernetes manifest validator
description: Validate Kubernetes YAML manifests against the official API schemas, or start from a template.

name: Mock data generator
description: Generate fake names, emails, addresses and other test data as JSON, CSV or SQL inserts.

name: Code to image
description: Turn a code snippet into a syntax-highlighted PNG image, with themes, padding and line numbers.

name: String escaper
description: Escape and unescape strings for JSON, JavaScript, SQL, shell, regular expressions, CSV and XML.

name: Docker cheatsheet
description: Searchable reference of Docker and Docker Compose commands for images, containers, volumes and networks.

name: Kubernetes cheatsheet
description: Searchable reference of kubectl commands for pods, deployments, services, logs and debugging.

name: Vim cheatsheet
description: Searchable reference of Vim motions, editing commands, search, registers, windows and buffers.

name: tmux cheatsheet
description: Searchable reference of tmux sessions, windows, panes, copy mode and key bindings.
